build.title: Owner recognized everywhere + veto countdown only on shell commands

said.text: URGENT, boss order from Brett, Nov 12. Two problems: 1) The console and axHub do not recognize Brett as the owner, so owner-only settings (Claude settings > Approvals & veto tab, policy changes) don't work for him. Fix owner detection so Brett's admin console login and his axHub session count as owner everywhere (check the earlier owner-only-settings-brett-s-admin-console-login-counts-as-owner build and claude-settings-tabs-veto s4, axHub owner-only policy API GET/PUT /auth/api/policy; finish whatever is missing). 2) Change the axHub approval policies: a veto countdown ONLY on shell commands that run on the VPS (vps.run and anything executing a shell). Everything in the console/orchestrator (axf-console control_add, control_set, control_act, build_orchestrator_pipeline_queue, priority_set, agent_slots settings, console_open/show, etc.) becomes allow, no countdown. Keep confirm on the few owner-only items that already need it (model upgrades). Repos: axHub and AmberX-AXF. Tests: Brett's session is owner; vps.run still held on veto; console/orchestrator tools run immediately. PR, land through the gate, redeploy, AmberX FYI when live. Don't stop to ask.

# Build: owner-recognized-everywhere-veto

## Brett said (verbatim)
> 

## What to build
Continue build "Owner recognized everywhere + veto countdown only on shell commands" (owner-recognized-everywhere-veto) [axhub] — Phase 1, model Opus.
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Branch: claude/owner-recognized-everywhere-veto · PR #601
Steps in this phase (1 left, ~20 min):
[x] s1 (~30 min) Fix owner detection: Brett's admin console login and axHub session count as owner everywhere; finish the axHub owner-only policy API (GET/PUT /auth/api/policy) and the Approvals & veto tab so Brett can change policies himself.
[x] s2 (~25 min) Set axHub policies: veto countdown ONLY for shell commands on the VPS (vps.run and anything executing a shell); all console/orchestrator tools to allow; keep confirm on model upgrades.
[ ] s3 (~20 min) Tests (owner recognized, vps.run still veto, console/orchestrator tools run immediately), PR, land, redeploy, AmberX FYI when live.
Tick each step right after its commit: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step owner-recognized-everywhere-veto <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link owner-recognized-everywhere-veto --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.

## Pipeline
This session was started by the orchestrator's dispatcher on Claude account mossesx-max- for the Opus phase. Work through every step of the phase in this one session: they are checkpoints, not separate tasks. As each step finishes, commit it on your branch, push, and tick it (orchestrator.mjs act step owner-recognized-everywhere-veto <stepId> done), then go straight on to the next; nothing is lost if the session dies, the next one starts at the first open step on the same branch. When this phase's steps are done, stop: the dispatcher starts the next phase on the right account. If you must stop early with steps left, say why in a build note (orchestrator.mjs act note owner-recognized-everywhere-veto "…"); the build goes back to Pending for Brett.

steps.text: Fix owner detection: Brett's admin console login and axHub session count as owner everywhere; finish the axHub owner-only policy API (GET/PUT /auth/api/policy) and the Approvals & veto tab so Brett can change policies himself.
Set axHub policies: veto countdown ONLY for shell commands on the VPS (vps.run and anything executing a shell); all console/orchestrator tools to allow; keep confirm on model upgrades.
Tests (owner recognized, vps.run still veto, console/orchestrator tools run immediately), PR, land, redeploy, AmberX FYI when live.

open: `orchestrator_upgrade_approve` is `confirm`, which under `AXHUB_CONFIRM_AS=veto` shows as a countdown (it never runs without the window). A straight approval for an explicit `confirm` needs a policy engine change (Fable).
`claude-accounts` decides owner from `user.admin`, which the console token also has: looser than `control@1 owner()`, left as is (not a recognition problem).
